- **Frontend & Design Engineering**: TypeScript, React.js, Next.js, HTML5, CSS3, Component Libraries, Figma-to-Code Implementation.

- **Remote Availability**: Operating seamlessly across European timezones (CET, BST/GMT, WEST) and US EST.
